EditInfo.description: The text change made by an edit tool. Enables symbol-level claims.

new_text.description: The text it is replaced with.

Phase.description: The moment in a session at which an event is raised.

oneOf.description: Before the harness runs a tool. The engine's decision gates the call.
After the harness ran a tool. Used to attribute what actually changed.
A session started. No tool is involved.
The user submitted a prompt. No tool is involved.
A session ended. No tool is involved.

SpecVersion.description:
The `spec` field of a document: the version of the ACS spec it was written against.

The only supported value is `"acs/0.1"`. Readers MUST reject any other value.

Tool.description: The tool a `pre_tool` or `post_tool` event refers to.

kind.description: What the tool does, as classified by the adapter.

name.description: The harness's own name for the tool, for example `Edit` or `Bash`.

ToolKind.description: What a tool does, as far as ACS is concerned. Adapters map each harness tool onto one kind.

oneOf.description: Creates a file or overwrites it entirely.
Modifies part of an existing file.
Moves or renames files. `paths` lists the source followed by the destination.
Runs a shell command. The command text is in `command`.
Anything else (search, web fetch, MCP tools, ...).

ToolResult.description: The outcome of a tool call. Present on `post_tool` events only.

exit_code.description: The exit code, for shell commands.

description:
The canonical event: what every adapter produces from a harness payload.

`pre_tool` and `post_tool` events MUST carry `tool`; session events (`session_start`,
`prompt_submit`, `session_end`) do not. Unknown fields are ignored so that newer producers
remain readable.

command.description: The shell command text, when `tool.kind` is `shell`.

cwd.description: Absolute working directory of the harness process when the event was raised.

edit.description: The text change, when the tool is an edit and the harness exposes it.

harness.description:
Name of the harness that produced the event, for example `claude-code` or `antigravity`.
A free-form string so new adapters need no schema change; `canonical` marks synthetic
events (tests, the conformance suite).

harness_session_id.description: The harness's own identifier for the session. One harness session is one seat.

paths.description:
Paths the tool touches, exactly as the harness gave them: absolute, or relative to `cwd`.
Normalization happens later in the pipeline.

phase.description: When in the session this event was raised.

prompt.description:
The user's prompt. `prompt_submit` only. Implementations MUST NOT store it unless
`ledger.store_prompts` is enabled.

raw.description: The original harness payload, kept for debugging only. Never interpreted.

spec.description: The spec version this event conforms to. Always `acs/0.1`.

tool.description: The tool involved. Absent for session phases.

title: ToolEvent
